name: vsblox
description: Dock Roblox Studio as a panel inside VS Code.

vsblox.studioSize.markdownDescription: Size of the Roblox Studio window inside the panel: `fit` to fill the panel, or `WIDTHxHEIGHT` in pixels (like `1920x1080`). A fixed size is centered in the panel and cut off at its edges if the panel is smaller.

vsblox.autoLaunchStudio.description: Launch Roblox Studio automatically when the panel opens and Studio isn't running.

vsblox.hideTitleBar.description: Hide Roblox Studio's Windows title bar inside the panel. Studio's own File/Plugins/Help menus stay visible.
